pages.name: French: Advance, Euwe, 6.Be2
pages.notes: 6.Be2 Euwe: plan 1 had f4-f5 behind the f3-knight; overview generic. Rewrote overview and both plans around d4 (Na3-c2, ...Nge7-f5, ...Qb6, ...cxd4, ...f6).

pages.name: French: Advance, Euwe, 6.Be2 Nge7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had exf6 before any ...f6; plans 3-4 vague (bad bishop via ...a6-b5, control of d4). Rewrote overview and all four plans.

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Guimard Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Qb6 and ...c5 with the c6-knight blocking the c-pawn and the c7-pawn blocking the queen. Rewrote overview and plans; first rewrite said the c-pawn break was impossible outright, reviewer rejected, reworded and re-accepted.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, 3...Be7 4.Bd3 c5 5.dxc5 Nf6
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Nxc5 with no knight able to reach c5; overview generic. Rewrote overview and plans (Qe2, ...Bxc5, ...Nc6-b4).

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Guimard Defense, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f4-f5 behind the f3-knight; plan 2 said ...f6 frees the light-squared bishop; overview described 5.e5 as already played. Rewrote overview and plans.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Guimard, 4.Ngf3 Nf6 5.e5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...c5 (blocked by the c6-knight) and ...Qb6 (blocked by c7); plan 1 had f4-g4 behind the f3-knight. Rewrote overview and all four plans; overview reworded once after reviewer rejection.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Guimard, Main Line, 6.Be2
pages.notes: Plan 3 had knights heading to f5 and c4 with no route; plan 4 vague. Rewrote overview and plans 3-4, British spelling in plans 1-2.

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Guimard, Main Line, 6.Nb3
pages.notes: Plan 1 had f4-f5 behind the f3-knight; plan 2 had ...c5 with the c6-knight blocking. Rewrote overview and plans (Bf4, ...f6, ...a5-a4).

pages.name: French: Tarrasch, Guimard, Main Line, 6.Nb3 Be7
pages.notes: Plans 2-4 built on a ...c5 break the c6-knight blocks and a d7-knight route to f8 where the bishop stands. Rewrote overview and all four plans; overview claimed a Bb5 pin the d7-knight blocks, reviewer rejected, reworded and re-accepted.

pages.name: French Defense: Tarrasch Variation, Botvinnik Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had ...Qb6 with a pawn on b6; plan 2 had Ne2-f3 (not a knight move) and Ba3 with the c1-bishop shut in. Rewrote both plans; overview kept.
